entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.11.0r2
entry.content: ## Changes Change the bot team mid-run, build your own loadouts, scale robot health, and weapon buffs in place of spare cash. Two of them came from kelly-cs. ### Change the team without ending the run - A **Bot Switcher** tab, between the mission list and the log, in the window and in the terminal. It shows what each seat plays and carries, and one button hands a new team to the server. - Saving a bot setting no longer restarts the server. Every other setting still does, because the game reads those once at startup. - `!ap bots` opens the same team in the game, seat then class. - The bots keep the money they earned across a switch. Measured: every one came back holding its full 400 credits and spent it within seconds. - A change made during a wave waits for the break. A bot pulled out mid-wave drops its buildings, and its replacement starts again from spawn. ### Build your own loadouts - A **Loadouts** page in the settings. Pick a class, pick a weapon per slot, name it, save it. The saved ones join every weapon menu for that class. - 251 weapons, taken from what the bot mod can hand out and named from the game's own files. - Remove a loadout and any seat still naming it plays stock. The team survives. ### Balancing - A **Balancing** page with a robot health scale, and the old Balancing page is **Rewards**. What the robots are worth and what the run hands out are different questions. - Robot health is what the robots keep with one player on RED, rising back to 100 at six. A full team plays the mission as Valve wrote it. It starts at 100, which changes nothing. - At 50 the bots killed 108 robots a wave, against 52 to 64 unscaled, and cleared three waves in eight where twenty four attempts cleared none. ### Weapon buffs, by kelly-cs - Spare checks award stackable weapon buffs instead of cash. Cash is spent inside the wave it arrives in; a buff lasts the run. - Extra rockets, grenades, stickies, arrows, bolts, flares, syringes, energy projectiles and thrown jars. - On by default, at three quarters of the spare checks. - Test mode hands out weapon buffs early enough to try them. They were last in a list of seventeen thousand, so the first one arrived about sixty waves in. ### Community maps, by kelly-cs - Optional community mission support. Nothing bundles third-party assets: the launcher fetches what you choose, or imports a ZIP you already have. - The list keeps Valve and community missions apart. - A map with no bot navigation file shows red, and the list refuses it. The bots cannot walk it. - The launcher checks the missions you picked can satisfy the run before it generates anything. - Offer every stock-compatible mission found for the 19 supported community maps. Mission source checks now also verify wave, tank, and giant metadata so Archipelago cannot generate an objective the selected mission lacks. ### The bots - Snipers with the stock rifle no longer stand where they shopped for the whole mission. They were never given the sniper role, so the game never sent them to a perch: a sniper carrying any other rifle worked, which is what made it look like a weapon problem. Only servers with custom loadouts on were affected. - A bot hat the class cannot wear is turned down instead of throwing, which used to cost that bot the rest of its cosmetics. - Engineers no longer freeze in one spot and build nothing. A bot stuck three times in the same place is moved onto ground around him he can walk on. On Mannworks that took a run from crashing before the first wave to four clean waves, and a team that cleared none of six waves cleared six of nine. - The wave-start stutter on Mannhattan is gone with it. The worst frame in a wave fell from 1833 ms to 141 ms, because a bot that cannot move asks the game for a route every frame. - The mod moves a defender that cannot leave spawn to the objective. Some community maps have navigation the bots will not use, and it happens on Valve maps too. Also by kelly-cs. - One press of the build button makes one building. Engineers built a second dispenser and a second sentry. - A sentry buster blowing itself up is no longer counted as a giant. - `sm_redbots_feature_watch_idle_bots` sets the switch it names. It set a different one before. Stock snipers standing at the upgrade bench is still open. Nothing in this release changes it. ### Under it - The settings window opens on a settings file written before the Balancing page existed. It refused to open at all, because the robot health scale read back as zero and the window will not take a number below ten. - The minus button at the upgrade station gives back credits that came from a cash bundle. Taking one upgrade back used to leave you with less than you started with. - A crash in the launcher's background work no longer closes the window and stops the server you are playing on. It is caught and written to the log a debug bundle carries. - The window and the terminal offer the same tabs and write the same settings. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * Add Archipelago weapon buff upgrades by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/3 * Optional Community Map Support by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/2 * Add all remaining community mission variants by @kelly-cs in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/4 ## New Contributors * @kelly-cs made their first contribution in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/3 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.10.0...v1.11.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZjI5NzRiMjliZDkzMzEzODhjMWIxNzk3YmI2YjNmYWI6MTc4Nzk1ODk1MQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/OWRlZDlhNGJhMTYyMDNjYzBjYTQyYTVmMDZiY2NmY2M6MTc4Nzk1ODk1Ng==/detection)

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.2.0r2
entry.content:
Two questions this build can answer that the last one could not.
At session start the game now reports what the player can ACTUALLY build, by asking IsEngineBuildable for every engine — the same function the build window asks:
[AP] Buildable right now: 5 (trains=1 road=3 ships=0 aircraft=1) [AP] buildable engine ids: 15 132 219 253 345
And the five-second engine lock sweep now says when it takes something away, and how many engines it is protecting. That set lives only in memory and is never saved, so if it were ever empty during a session the sweep would quietly remove the player's whole fleet:
[AP] LockSweep: relocked N engine(s); AP-unlocked set holds M
The engine is otherwise unchanged from v2.1.2.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.2.0r3
entry.content:
Received items are actually applied now. Every item London relayed arrived carrying only its id — the name field was empty — and the code gave up on an empty name instead of resolving the id through slot_data's item_id_to_name table. Measured in a live session: five shop purchases and three stars all registered on the server, the items all came back, and not one was applied. No engine in the build list, no ferry, and a Cash Injection £200,000 that never became money. The starting vehicles masked it, because they are granted on a different path.
An item that cannot be resolved is now said out loud in the console log instead of vanishing.
The window title tells the truth. The version stamp comes from a .ap_version file that overrides git and had said v2.0.4 since the 20th; the packer now refuses an engine whose stamp does not match the release.
If you load an existing save, your vehicles arrive on reconnect but already-consumed cash items do not — item replay skips consumables by design. Starting the seed's world fresh delivers everything, including the money.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.3.0
entry.content:
The seed's settings are now locked once the world exists. Map size, economy, vehicle limits, station spread and forty-one other settings the seed decides were all still editable in the settings window during a session — and the change is saved, so it survived for the rest of the multiworld while the game quietly disagreed with everyone else's. All 45 are refused now, in SettingDesc::IsEditable, which every route to a setting goes through: the window greys the entry out, the console refuses, and a network client cannot push it either.
Maximum train length and station spread stop over-promising. The engine stores both in a uint8_t and its own table declares max 255 — already raised from vanilla's 64. The world offered up to 1000 and 1024, and those were silently clamped on arrival, so asking for a 1000-tile train got 255 with no warning anywhere. Both options now end at 255, which is what the engine can actually deliver.
Fast forward works again as a consequence of v2.1.4: Speed Boost is an item, and until items were applied at all it could never raise the limit.

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.4.0
entry.content:
Maps can be 4096x4096. That is the engine's own ceiling — map_type.h declares MAX_MAP_SIZE_BITS = 12, and the two axes are validated independently, so nothing stood in the way except the world only ever offering 2048. Sixteen point seven million tiles: generation takes minutes and the map alone wants gigabytes, so it is offered rather than recommended.
Known cost on a map that size: the God of Wackens punishment levels 4 and 5 walk every tile to find your rail. With Wrath enabled on 4096x4096 that is a visible pause each time he strikes. Ruins and stars are unaffected — they pick random tiles rather than scanning.

entry.title: MegaMan Battle Network 6 v0.2.0
entry.content:
# Beta - v0.2.0
> [!WARNING] > This has been tested and appears to be stable, but there could still be some unknown issues. Please save regularly, and report any bugs you encounter by opening up an issue, or via the Discord thread: https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1242860924092682481
- Game Page: [EN](https://github.com/RischDev/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/mmbn6/docs/en_MegaMan%20Battle%20Network%206.md) - Setup Page: [EN](https://github.com/RischDev/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/mmbn6/docs/setup_en.md)
Compatibility Notes - AP version: v0.6.7 - Other versions have not been tested at this time.
## Changelog **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/RischDev/Archipelago/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0
### New Features - ROMless generation has been added. Now, the host of a multiworld does not require the base Gregar or Falzar ROM in order to generate a world with BN6 in it. - Multiple requests can now be selected at a time. Requests will still be locked by your rank, but this means that you can immediately start all 11 one-star requests, and once you reach rank B, you can select all two-star requests. This prevents softlocks due to grabbing the wrong request. - Bass BX and ProtoMan FZ have been added as potential checks. This also adds ColForce Q and HubBatch J (vanilla rewards for Bass BX in Gregar and Falzar respectively) to the pool. - Added a Progressive Link Navi Item to the pool. Each world will generate with 4 copies of this item, which will upgrade all of the link navi's levels as they would normally due to story progression.
### Changes - Virus deletion counts will now start at 32. This means that once you get the BtlrCard, all rare viruses will become immediately available without additional grinding.
### Bug Fixes - VacData is now a requirement before beginning GroundMan class. When you talk to Moliarty, if you don't have VacData, he will inform you that it is required and will not let you start the class. This prevents potential softlocks.
## Status - ROMless generation has been added via APProcedurePatch - Gregar and Falzar both supported - Upcoming Features: - Virus randomization. - New checks like ProtoMan and other link navi fights. - Optional goals, like Bass, Bass SP, Bass BX, Beast SP, or ProtoMan FZ.
### Checks - Base pool: 297 - Settings: - Request Rewards: 38 - EX Bosses: 6 - SP Bosses: 6 - Graveyard checks: 8 - Virus Battler checks: 5 - Bass BX: 1 - ProtoMan FZ: 1 - Total with all exclusions: 232 - Locations per region (all options enabled): - Central Town: 105 - Central Internet: 10 - Central 3/Underground: 11 - Seaside Town: 34 - Seaside Internet: 17 - Green Town: 21 - Green Internet: 17 - Sky Town: 31 - Sky Internet: 15 - ACDC Town: 3 - ACDC Internet: 6 - Undernet: 7 - Graveyard: 8 - Expo Site: 12
## Known Issues - The client is required for certain location checks (specifically EX and SP bosses) to give items, and is required to set flags when receiving Crosses, BeastOut, and BtlrCard items. As such, playing offline will not fully work, so players cannot play on console for single player games yet, and you must be connected to the client to fully experience the game. - Skipping a cutscene that can give an item (such as after Link Navi classes or after Bass/Bass SP) can result in not receiving a local item. The location check will still be sent, but if it's a local item, it will need to be received via a `/send` command. Try to avoid skipping these cutscenes until after you see the `get item` textbox. - Certain checks that could theoretically scout their contents (such as WWW ID and BtlrCard navis) are not currently scoutable locations. As such, before buying the items, they will display the wrong item. - Fighting Bass always gives the BatKey, even if it is located elsewhere. You can still get the randomized item from this location (don't skip the cutscene for local items), but you will get BatKey as well. - Fighting Bass SP will always give the version-specific giga chip.You can still get the randomized item from this location (don't skip the cutscene for local items), but you will get the giga chip as well. - The puddle to Seaside Area from Central 3 is not a 2-way obstacle. As such, you can go from Seaside into Central 3 even without `ToolPrgm`, but you can't go from Central 3 to Seaside without it. - `AreaPass` does give access to ACDC Area, but the invisible obstacle can only be cleared during the right chapter of the story. You need to trigger the dialogue, then you can enter a menu and close it to re-load the map and clear the obstacle. - Request Points will still display the wrong number of request points under certain circumstances. However, the patch will correctly calculate the appropriate number of request points based on the completion flags, so this can be safely ignored.
## Other info For a full list of area requirements of requests, you can reference this [Pastebin](https://pastebin.com/nmb1a562)

entry.title: OpenTTD v2.5.0
entry.content:
**The seed's settings now reach the game.** World generation is deferred by a turn of the main loop, and the NewGRF scan's config reload landed in that gap and overwrote everything the seed had chosen — train length, station spread, vehicle limits and the rest, which were then baked into the savegame. The settings are applied again at the moment the world is built, and a world generated with the wrong values is repaired when it is loaded.
**Engine** - Reconnecting mid-session no longer replays every item (double money, re-fired traps) and no longer loses mission progress. - Infrastructure locks only bind the player — towns can grow their roads and industries can level ground again. - Server-synced missions and the Mission Check task reward now count toward shop and tier unlocks. - Trap timers no longer run while paused; your own DeathLink no longer bounces back onto you; the Colby event can no longer stall permanently. - Shop hints are requested at session start, so slots can show who holds what.
**apworld 2.5.0** — new seeds need this version; existing seeds still play. - Every goal is clamped to what the seed can actually supply: missions, vehicles, town counts. - Multiplayer mode really removes ruins, stars, Colby and demigods now. - Missions and Colby only name cargo that exists in the chosen landscape and FIRS economy. - An unlock can no longer be placed behind the tier it unlocks.
**Plugin 1.5.0** — needs launcher 3.21.2 or newer. - Standalone sessions connect properly; a game crash during startup no longer hangs the launcher; a fresh install gets ruins and stars in its first seed. - The plugin source is back in this repository, under `plugin/`.
This release is machine-verified (generation proven at the option extremes) but has not yet been played through — see KNOWN_BUGS.md, and report anything on BetaHub.

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.4
entry.content:
Tons of bug fixes from the reports on the last release. Biggest ones were the glitched NPC dialogue rewards and Cerveau disappearing and remaining inaccessible. [Check out the full readme before playing.](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) # Features ## Hint and track by group Items and locations are sorted into groups now, so commands like `!hint` can be used on a category. | locations | | | --- | --- | | by stage | `Resistance Base` (all three mission sets), `Aegis Volcano Base`, `Sunken Library`, ... | | by type | `Secret Disks`, `Stage Clears`, `Chips`, `A+ Rank Clears`, `Subtanks`, `Weapons`, `1-UPs`, `Minibosses` | | items | | | --- | --- | | by type | `Secret Disks`, `Stage Access`, `Chips`, `Body Chips`, `Foot Chips`, `Head Chips`, `EX Skills`, `Subtanks`, `Weapons` | Try using `!hint Stage Access` or `!missing Resistance Base`. Works in the Yaml too. ```yaml Mega Man Zero 3: exclude_locations: [1-Ups] start_hints: [Stage Access] local_items: [Weapons] ``` ## Intermission cutscenes are reimplemented Some missions in the vanilla game start by a cutscene starting which forces you into the level. These have been brought back and will now play when you start the mission through the mission select screen. Mission include: Starting cutscenes from Missile Factory and Sub Arcadia. Ending cutscenes from Derelict Spacecraft, Missile Factory, and Area X-2. You are still able to skip these. ## New NPC in Cerveau's room Cerveau leaves his room once the maintenance bay cutscene with Harpuia is supposed to be activated. There is now a resistance soldier standing in his spot waiting to direct you to his location.
(The bug where that cutscene is inaccessible until clearing certain stages has also been fixed) ## Starting weapons If you leave `starting_weapons` empty and you now get one random weapon. If you start with the Shield Boomerang only, another one gets added to your inventory so you can still attack with the charged attack. # Bug Fixes - Completing the game no longer prompts you to save the game. Effectively removing new game plus and any bugs it had. NG+ is not really that important anyway since you can replay levels with all your items regardless. - The cutscene with Harpuia in the maintenance room is no longer gated behind certain levels being cleared. Should now always be accessible once you have the second story progress item. - Cerveau, Hirondelle, Doigt and Rocinolle now give their items once Story Progress has been sent. Previously they would also check if Area X-2 was cleared in addition to the story progress. This has been fixed to be just the story progress item. - A+ Rank Clear: Sub Arcadia was in the Giant Elevator region for some reason. - Loading a save used to drop you into a level or replay a cutscene based on levels cleared. This has been fixed. - Talking to Ciel would launch Sub Arcadia. Also fixed. - The Sunken Library's disks are now represented properly on the mission select screen. - Fixed the item received indicator palettes being messed up on the mission select screen. # Known bugs - The game got a bit laggier the further you got into a run, since the game does all of the AP logic every frame. This has been optimized, but the game might still have a few stutters when you get late into a run. Will be improved more later. - Note that the game still lags in vanilla, so its not all from this mod. Still aiming to move this world from unstable to stable, so keep reporting bugs :)

entry.title: Rimworld v0.6.1a0
entry.content:
### Version 0.6.1 Release!
## Features
* Advanced setup improvements
1. New folder functionality - no more hunting down the right Documents folder 2. An "Open folder" button - open right to the folder with the new files 3. An auto-package of the apworld - no more messing with zipped files
* Version and ItemDef error handling
1. An error will display if the versions don't match between client and apworld 2. An error will display if ItemDefs don't match
* Options to vary research costs
1. ResearchCostVariance: The cost for each research will increase by a random number up to this amount 2. ResearchCostIncreasePerTier: Each tier (column) will increase by this static amount. 3. Both are optional.
## Bugfixes
* Universal Tracker craft locations were displaying incorrectly * Raid/trade location items could not be stockpiled
## Decided not to fix
* Tribute collectors will sell a trade location for 100 honor - I put together a fix for this, but it also prevented normal imperial traders from selling trade locations. It's a little messy this way, but fixing it for real is too much of a pain.

entry.title: Pokemon Platinum v0.2.0
entry.content: ## Changelog ### Added * Universal tracker YAML-less support. * A location for the bag item. * GBA cartridge items and locations for them. * A linking cable item and a location for it. * TMs for Rollout, Ancient Power, Double Hit, and Mimic, and corresponding locations for them. * AP items now display their name and destination when picked up. * A location for the S.S. Ticket. * A location for the Marsh Pass. * Daytime and nighttime items. * An option to normalize encounter slot probabilities. * Dexsanity support, including partial. * Trainersanity support, including partial. * Instant text speed option. * Death Link support. * Starter randomization. * Encounter randomization, including special encounters. * Trainer party randomization. * Hold A to advance option. * Randomizing the species that Rowan shows during the intro. * A clerk in the fourth floor of the Veilstone Department Store, who sells non-reusable evolution items after they have been previously obtained. He also sells TM70 Flash. * An option for reusable TMs. * An option to have a 100% catch rate. * Cheats in the client. * Swarms can now be attracted by berries. * AP Helper NPC to 2nd floors of all Pokémon Centers. * Dowsing Machine Upgrades to identify munchlax honey trees and feebas fishing tiles. * An item to allow use of field moves without a party member knowing them. * An option to just talk to trainers. (useful for trainersanity) * Added option groups to the WebWorld and the template YAML ([@snowflav-goob](https://github.com/snowflav-goob)) * The slot name is now stored in the ROM, so it does not need to be entered when BizHawk Client connects. * There is now an option to have "relaxed" player and rival name conversion, which replaces unknown characters and truncates appropriately. * An event for defeating Team Galactic at Stark Mountain. * The boat can now be taken between Canalave City, Pastoria City, and Snowpoint City. * More options for roadblocks in Routes 207, 210, and 215. * A Poketch app to modify the camera type and make the player invisible. * An option to include fly regions as locations. * An option to filter item notifications by classification. * The R button can be held to stop receiving items. * An option to add TM/HM compatibility. * An option for fast fishing. * Entries to the game credits. * Version number to title screen. * A QOL menu when pressing the select button. * An option to prevent the PopTracker from spoiling optional roadblocks, and client support for the option. * `Field Machines` item group. * `start_inventory_from_pool` option. * `game_debug` client command. ### Changed * In-game game options option is now validated before generation. * Some evolution stones have been key-itemified, and are no longer consumed when used. * Honey trees no longer have a 6 hour delay for encounters. Honey trees no longer have bad odds when using the same tree twice in a row. * The trophy garden can now be quickly reset. * Locations that check for number of seen species now require the Pokédex. * Poké Radar no longer needs to recharge. * Remote items now have more options regarding which items are remote. * There is no longer an option to show unrandomized progression items. * The Great Marsh binoculars now reset the special encounters in the Great Marsh when they are checked. * Up to 64 items can be received at once (when using none item notification). * The experience multiplier now supports fractional values. It is now modifiable in-game. * Changed to rule builder. * Scientist in Sunyshore no longer requires Pokémon of specific natures. * A lot of item classification changes to better reflect their usefulness ([@Justior-l](https://github.com/Justior-l), [@palex00](https://github.com/palex00)) * The Pokétch is now the requirement to access Route 203 from Jubilife, instead of the parcel and three coupons. * The bicycle can now be used indoors. * The escape rope can now be used in lost tower. * Title screen logo. * The female cyclist in the upper left of cycling road now moves around. * The journal is now a trap item. * Various location name changes. * VS Seeker location is now correctly classified as a `key_item` location. * Structure of version data in client now better supports backwards compatibility. ### Fixed * Non-determinism of generation. (hopefully) * Elite Four rematch is triggered only if the game has been completed and stark mountain has been cleared. * The bag now shows the amount of collected unown file items. * Team Galactic Grunts now disappear if you defeat Mars before hitting the Route 205 South trigger. * Correct Rev. 0 ROM is now being used for diffs. * APWorld building is now compatible with Archipelago 7. * Triggering the second Galactic warehouse scene before defeating Maylene and doing the first scene is no longer possible. * Victory Road room after defeating Cynthia now requires Defog logically. * Fixed bug where received items can occasionally be lost. * Triggers cannot be walked through when receiving items. * The clown in front of Jubilife TV now moves immediately after the Team Galactic event in Jubuilife City, instead of requiring leaving and re-entering. * Fixed broken texture in Route 214. * Remove badge requirement option has incorrect effect. * The bag can no longer be used in the Great Marsh if it has not yet been obtained. ### Removed * The `all` key item option no longer exists. * The `hm_badge_requirement` option no longer exists.

entry.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v0.8.0r2
entry.content:
### Changes - Add a proper Archipelago markdown guide to the docs. [Read this if you want to learn about randomization for this APWorld](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/en_Crypt_of_the_NecroDancer.md). - Add already established option groups property to CotNDWeb like it should have been in the first place. - This allows for option groups to appear in Options Creator instead of the unorganized mess it was previously. - Add display name to `starting_inventory` option. - Fix issue related to All Zones speedrun times setting defaults showing up as `1` for each character in Options Creator. Changed the default to `-1` now to represent being disabled. - [This issue was caused by Options Creator handling OptionCounter `0` values as falsy](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/pull/6221). - If values are manually set to `0`, this is also treated as disabled. Any value less than `3` and greater than `0` are still set to `3` default. I understand 3 minutes is an absurd standard for completing an All Zones Mode run, but for now, if a player sets their speedrun timers to an unrealistic standard, that's on the player. If this turns out to be more of a problem in the future, logic can be added to set minimum speedrun timers for each character as opposed to a uniform 3 minutes. - Fix options descriptions to be more accurate and consistent with each other.
Please see the [setup file](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/setup_en.md) for getting started.
Please inform me of any issues through the associated [Crypt of the NecroDancer channel in the Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1192775219740422176) or through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/issues).

entry.title: Cursed Words v0.5.2
entry.content:
## Information This archipelago implementation is in **early development** and is in public pre-release for testing, so may not be complete and/or may contain bugs that heavily disrupt the experience. It is not advised to include this in large multiworlds at this time, so only do so at your own risk and inform your host beforehand.
## Setup Guide Please visit the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago#setup-guide) for instructions on how to install the mod client.
## Issue / Bug Reporting If you experience issues that are not already on the [known issues list](https://github.com/JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago/issues/views/12865), please raise a new issue or post in the [Cursed Words Forum in the Archipelago Discord Server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1499176806962692196)
## Patch Notes This patch provides the following fixes: ### APWorld - Further improvements to sticker/stamp groupings for characters _(including metadata of tags used by in-game vanilla)_ - Fixed typos / mis-matches for `King Of The Bridge`, `Glass Of Milk` and `Sequoia Sapling` ### Client - Save slot menu now displays last known Slot Name and Checked Locations count for each save. - Items received now trigger an in-game notification. - In-game text-client console provided to view activity history and send messages/commands - Processing `Force Grid Re-roll` item now correctly waits for the entire re-roll procedure to finish before processing the next item. - `Money Earned` locations are no longer attempted to be checked if the money total has _decreased_.
